subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite this stale branch on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close it after a replacement owns the linked Dashboard recovery issue?
rationale: The branch is conflicting across current protocol and chat lifecycle boundaries, and the remaining choice combines ownership, proof, and session/message-delivery semantics rather than one narrow mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers, the live protocol package, and restart-only shutdown semantics.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original author can refresh the branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard reconnect/tab-return plus restart-notice proof before another review.

options.title: Close after a viable replacement
options.body: If another proof-positive PR becomes the canonical fix for the linked issue, this stale branch can be closed as superseded.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
